##### Project general facts

Lamar is a villa cluster by DAMAC Properties, inspired by the serene beauty of tranquil lakes, where homes are designed around nature-inspired water views. The collection offers luxury four and five bedroom villas set over several levels, each with front and back gardens and a central courtyard with a private pool.

Homes come with a smart home set-up, integrated air conditioning and ventilation and solar-powered water heating. The secure gated community is supported by round-the-clock security and surveillance, an on-site power substation, an advanced water supply grid, periodic maintenance services and integrated facility management.

The deluxe four bedroom villas feature formal and informal living and dining areas, a kitchen, a ground-floor office with a bathroom, a storage room, a laundry and shaded parking. The upper floor holds the master bedroom with a walk-in closet and bathroom and further bedrooms with bathrooms and walk-in closets, while the top level adds a games room, a maid's room and a terrace.

##### Location description and benefits

DAMAC Hills Baghdad is a gated residential community in the Iraqi capital, set near Baghdad International Airport and opposite Abbas Ibn Firnas Square. It sits away from the hustle of the city centre yet is well connected by major roads that offer easy access to both banks of the Tigris River.

The area is close to leading universities, prestigious academic institutions and luxury hotels, while the Green Zone and the Al Mansour district are a short drive away. Recognised as the first and largest residential community of its kind in the city, the district offers a calm, secure setting suited to family life.

The community brings the lifestyle of the original DAMAC Hills in Dubai to Baghdad, offering secure gated living with green, tranquil surroundings. Its strategic location and comprehensive lifestyle offering make the district an attractive choice for both residents and investors.
